name: 华语流行编曲风格
desc: 讲清华语流行（国语/粤语）编曲的特有规则，以及哪些日系欧美手法能借用
descOriginal: Mandarin and Cantonese pop as a style layer (华语流行风格层). What is actually specific to Chinese-language pop rather than borrowed wholesale from J-pop and Anglo-American pop, the transfer table for what may and may not be carried in or out, the tone-melody constraint that shapes Mandarin and Cantonese melody writing and why it belongs to the lyrics library, what the corpus can currently support and what it cannot, and the declared gaps. Use when writing or arranging Mandarin or Cantonese pop, when deciding whether a J-pop or Western device fits, when a melody fights the words, or when choosing references. 华语流行、中文流行、国语、粤语、倒字、协音、华语编曲。

name: 普通话作词
desc: 讲清十三辙、平仄、字数与顿、易唱性，解决声调与旋律冲突，写出能唱的词
descOriginal: The Mandarin language layer for lyric writing (普通话作词的语言层). What Chinese as a language adds to the job: tone is phonemic, so the melody that enters a syllable can change which word is heard; one character is one syllable, so syllable count is character count; the thirteen rhyme families (十三辙) with their finals, example characters, wide-versus-narrow reach and loudness grades; how to pick a rhyme family, when to switch, and which families borrow from each other; level-and-oblique (平仄) and how much looser a lyric is than classical verse; the two- and three-character feet that make a Chinese line scan; and what makes a line easy or hard to sing. Use when writing or checking Mandarin lyrics, when choosing or changing a rhyme family, when a line is a tongue-twister or a high note lands on a closed vowel, when someone asks what 十三辙 is, or when LYR-LINT check 8 says the song sits on one or two wide families. 普通话、中文作词、十三辙、辙口、韵部、平仄、字调、易唱、绕口、开口音闭口音、什么是十三辙。

name: 中国风歌词
desc: 让中国风歌词的中国味“长出来”：词汇、修辞手法、意象成套和用典分寸
descOriginal: The Chinese-style layer for lyric writing (中国风歌词). What makes a lyric read as 中国风 rather than merely decorated - the vocabulary families it draws on (place, dynasty, object, craft, plant), the sixteen rhetorical devices Fang Wen-shan catalogues inside his own lyrics, each with a book example and a failure condition, why every image must belong to one material world and how one out-of-period object breaks it, the four grades of borrowing from classical verse and where borrowing becomes copying, what to do when the listener will not catch the allusion, what the words promise the arrangement when they name an instrument, and the three ways this style usually dies - ornament with no event, images unrelated to what the song says, and archaism for its own sake. Use when writing or auditing a 中国风 or 古风 lyric, when a draft is full of beautiful old words but says nothing, when checking an allusion, when images from different eras collide, or when the words name an instrument. 中国风、古风、典故、化用、文字游戏、修辞、意象成套、方文山、穿帮。

name: 妙响 AI 音乐创作
desc: 为妙响（汽水音乐）平台写结构化提示词：曲风公式、歌词金句、BGM 模板
descOriginal: Create AI music on 妙响 (MUSE SONG) — 汽水音乐 / 抖音音乐创作实验室's AI music platform. Use this skill WHENEVER the user wants to write music-generation prompts (提示词/structured prompts), pick or fuse a 曲风/genre (国风/民族国韵, EDM/电子, 动感流行, Rap/嘻哈, 禅意/ambient/梦核/纯音乐 BGM), write or refine song lyrics (歌词/金句/押韵/诗词句式), choose a generation model (Sway, SeedMusic, Mureka, MiniMax, TemPolor, Sodance, 音潮), troubleshoot AI output (唱错字/咬字/乱发挥), or optimize a track for 汽水 cold-start traffic (冷启/起量/完播率/30s跳出率/被选用/BGM). Trigger even when the user only describes the *outcome* (e.g. "help me make a creepy ambient BGM", "write me a viral hook", "why won't my new song get plays") without naming 妙响. Also trigger for batch/工作流/搬砖 music-generation planning.
requires: 需要妙响（汽水音乐）账号来生成音频；skill 只负责提示词与歌词

desc: 把AI腔改成真人口语，并把模糊想法写成精确到秒的分镜脚本
descOriginal: 视频口播脚本撰写，两大特色——(1) 去 AI 味，把书面/AI 腔改成能念出口的真人口语；(2) 把模糊想法逼成一份精确到秒的分镜脚本（每个镜头讲什么、怎么呈现、停多久、怎么切）。当用户说「写口播脚本」「这段太 AI 了改成人话」「口播稿」「分镜脚本」「精确到秒」「script」「改成能念的」时触发。输入可以是选题正文、一段草稿，或一句模糊描述。

descOriginal: 为微信公众号生成爆款选题方向和候选标题。有明确选题、文章描述、草稿或草稿标题时，输出多条不同公式的候选标题；只有关键词、简单想法或未给输入时，先给选题方向再配标题。 用于用户提到爆款标题、公众号标题、起标题、选题、不知道写什么、候选标题、公众号选题、爆款公众号时。 只做选题和标题，不写正文。

name: 影视飓风式口播稿
desc: 按影视飓风的口播结构，写开门见山的科技评测、科普和 vlog 口播稿
descOriginal: 生成「影视飓风(Mediastorm)」风格的中文口播稿。当用户需要写视频口播稿、解说词、 短视频文案、科技评测/科普/vlog 旁白,或明确要求「影视飓风风格/Tim 风格/飓风口播」时使用。 基于对影视飓风最新 19 条视频字幕的结构化分析,产出开门见山的钩子、分点主体、 数据+类比、自然的合作方植入、金句升华与固定 CTA 结尾的完整成稿。 适用触发词:口播稿、解说词、视频文案、旁白、影视飓风风格、科技评测文案、科普脚本。
